hero.prompt: A painterly editorial illustration of a South American twilight landscape — Colombian Andean foothills meeting a wide still sky. Most of the sky washed in cool Cancer silver-blue light, emotional, protective, and deep-water in tone, with a warm Jupiter amber-gold glow resting low on one side of the horizon, as if a benevolent planet is briefly visiting. Palette of deep indigo fading to near-black (#16112c to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), and a teal-and-gold nebula wash drifting across the upper sky. Contemplative, intense, full-bleed wide 16:9 atmosphere that fills the frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
